_comment: Genuinely useful gameplay tips, used in the friendly stage to make Verity feel helpful.

entries.text: Coal and iron are most common around y=16 to y=48. Bring torches!
Diamonds love deepslate. Try y=-59 with full iron gear.
A bed sets your spawn. Sleep before you go too far.
Villagers will trade with you. Emeralds are basically money.
Creepers hate cats. Keep one close to your base.
